sources.summary: Photographer Ahmad Alnaji has captured the Ciel Dubai Marina, a supertall skyscraper by architecture studio NORR that was recently completed as the tallest hotel in the world. Ciel Dubai Marina opened in November last year, rising 377 metres to beat the 356-metre-tall Gevora Hotel, also in Dubai, as the world's tallest hotel-only building.
